title: Practice: Cases, the nominative and the prepositional

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Layla worked at a strip joint called Aloha.
exercises.why: Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions в or на. — * об before a "hard" vowel (а, о, у, э) and и: об уроке, об Иване.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Антисемитские теории заговора полагаются на миф о еврейском ___ (единство).
exercises.prompt: Antisemitic conspiracy theories rely on the myth of Jewish unity.
exercises.why: (About what?) *Мы говорим о классе.* The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е. Certain neuter nouns of foreign origin never change their forms: кино, радио, пальто — в кино, о радио, о пальто. 1) If the stem of the noun ends in и-, the prepositional case singular has another -и as the ending (instead of -е): Россия — в России, здание — в здании. 2) Feminine nouns ending in -ь in the nominative singular have -и in the prepositional singular: тетрадь — в тетради, часть — о части, дверь — на двери. — * об before a "hard" vowel (а, о, у, э) and и: об уроке, об Иване.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: (About what?) *Мы говорим о классе.* The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is -е.
